figures.caption: Table 1. Executable Python vulnerability repair benchmarks. Exploit is a security test that distinguishes the vulnerable from the fixed revision; Functional is a non-security test suite required to keep passing on both revisions; Public indicates whether the instances and their execution environments are openly released. Vul4Py is the only benchmark that requires both oracles on every entry.

Fig. 1. The Vul4Py construction pipeline. Open-source advisories from OSV are linked to fix commits, filtered to fixes that add or modify tests, manually validated through Manual Oracle Validation, and packaged into reproducible per-instance workspaces, each carrying a paired functional and exploit oracle.

Fig. 2. Overall characteristics of the 100 Vul4Py instances: (a) distribution by CVE year, (b) the Python version provisioned for each instance, and (c) patch size measured as .py lines changed by the upstream fix.
